ja: キャラクターの魅力をオリジナルアレンジで“増幅”！『遊☆戯☆王デュエルモンスターズ』より、三幻神の一体「オベリスクの巨神兵」がAmplifiedに降臨！！
• 特徴的な技の「ゴッド・ハンド・クラッシャー」モードをAmplified解釈で表現。■胸部、肩部、腕部、翼に展開ギミックを搭載。翼膜のディテールは緻密なモールドで表現。■額の宝玉や歯などを洗練されたパーツ分割で表現。■脚部の可動で膝立ちのポーズも可能。■全高約235mm。迫力のボリューム感で圧倒的存在感を表現。
en: “Amplify” the charm of the characters with original arrangements! From "Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters", one of the three phantom gods, "Obelisk Giant Soldier", has arrived in Amplified! !

• Expressing the characteristic technique "God Hand Crusher" mode with an amplified interpretation. ■Equipped with deployment gimmicks on the chest, shoulders, arms, and wings. The details of the wing membrane are expressed with a precise mold. ■Representing the forehead jewels and teeth with sophisticated parts division. ■The legs are movable, allowing for kneeling poses. ■Total height approximately 235mm. Expressing an overwhelming presence with a powerful sense of volume.
